text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Do not worry. It is the same kind as the 
one you normally use.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove thought I might be running out 
of spares soon, you see.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Sharp as ever, I see. How did you 
notice?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You probably don't know this, but your 
hair ribbons are turned in to the student 
council room quite often.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Just the other day, one even popped out 
from between the cushions of the student 
council room sofa.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Most likely, she untied it from her hair 
during a nap and simply lost it there.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I included both the one you lost and a 
brand new one. Use them well.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...Tch. Don't go telling big sis, got 
it?"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I'll classify that as confidential 
student council info.
